messages:
Lina (product): quick sync — enterprise trial reported: rolling upgrades must keep tenant egress IP stable. they also asked for a slim installer that assumes customer-managed NAT. how do we prioritize?
Matt (eng): technical callouts: need safe drain for model-serving pods and KV cache continuity. operator-shim gives us controlled canaries; sidecar approach is faster but messier for rollback.
Sarah (netops): preserving egress IP is non-negotiable for some customers. recommend supporting customer NAT as primary and our relay as fallback. document BGP and static-route examples.
Jill (devops): packaging plan: three presets — full, slim, airgap. slim must expose a post-install IP pin check and a flag to opt into customer-NAT mode.
Lina (product): proposed launch criteria: 1) rolling upgrade with no >1min p99 spike; 2) pinned tenants retain identical egress IPs during rollout; 3) slim installer validated on >=2 field pilots; 4) rollback checklist and canary runbook published.
Matt (eng): testing: create harness simulating 50-100 tenants with pinned egress. rollout steps: canary -> 10% -> 50% -> 100%. add `/health/upgrade-ready` to signal drain completion.
Sarah (netops): add short BGP snippet for runbook: `neighbor 10.0.0.1 remote-as 65000`. include iptables fallback and sample validation `curl -sS https://ifconfig.me` (note privacy).
Jill (devops): slim flags draft: `installer_mode: slim`, `preserve_egress: true`, `relay_enabled: false`. will prototype `--force-ip-check`.
Lina (product): rough estimates for roadmap: operator + canary infra ~4 sprints (2 engs), packaging ~1 sprint, netops docs + field tests ~0.5 sprint + 2 weeks validation. slot high for Q2.
Matt (eng): ack. i'll stub PRD and test plan.
Jill (devops): will build the ip-check script and add installer preset tests.
Sarah (netops): scheduling two validation windows with field: one BGP, one customer-NAT.
ops-bot: created ticket RDW-5239: "private-deploy: egress-preserve + rolling-upgrade" assigned to Lina, Matt, Jill, Sarah. :white_check_mark:
Lina (product): thanks — i'll fold estimates into roadmap doc and loop in legal for SLA wording. walkthrough next Mon 30m.
Matt (eng): +1.
Jill (devops): added to calendar.
Sarah (netops): will pull real configs from customer field.
Lina (product): end.
